This is the pivot of the entire Torah: just as ארץ=אמונה absorbs and transforms inhabitants, the Tzaddik has the same transformative nature. The Tzaddik IS ארץ — same essential nature, not cause-and-effect. This bechina edge is the critical missing link in the dataset for Torah #129.

analysis_notes.summary: Torah #129 has a minimal bechina dataset (only 1 edge) relative to the richness of the source text. The most critical missing bechina edges are: (1) הצדיק↔ארץ — the central identification of the Torah, making the Tzaddik = Land = Faith; (2) תרין רעין↔מוחין קדושים — the internal spiritual counterpart. These two additions would bring the dataset's bechina graph for Torah #129 from 1 edge to 4 edges across 2 packages. The eitza edges already in the dataset are correctly classified.
